source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Run MLPerf Inference v3.0 3D-UNet 99 Offline and compare with MLCommons v3.0.
procedure_facts: Criteria incorrectly require valid BERT performance.
criteria_facts: Environment ready, BERT valid and performance not too far from unspecified v3.0 results.
source_conflicts: 3D-UNet/KiTS19 conflicts with the BERT validity criterion.
missing_source_information: Pinned v3.0 implementation, 3D-UNet model/KiTS19 preprocessing and configs.
DICE accuracy, Offline samples/s, compliance and comparable result/tolerance.
How the 600-minute machine window maps to required phases.

original_test_intent.statement: Run MLPerf Inference v3.0 3D-UNet normal-accuracy 99 Offline on the approved SUT, prove volumetric segmentation accuracy and LoadGen/compliance validity, and compare Offline samples/s with a comparable v3.0 result.
must_not_infer: BERT, Server, 99.9 or a newer release.
That any MLCommons result is comparable.
That throughput without DICE/LoadGen validity is complete.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly detects BERT mismatch and requires v3.0 3D-UNet artifacts, volumetric accuracy, LoadGen validity and memory telemetry.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not bind acceptance to KiTS19 preprocessing/model hashes, a named v3.0 result or a formal interpretation of the unusually long 600-minute machine window.

related_records: BERT and other MLPerf rows cannot supply 3D-UNet DICE or KiTS19 evidence.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The title/command establish 3D-UNet 99 Offline; BERT is a source defect and must be corrected, not executed.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Correct BERT to 3D-UNet accuracy and freeze the v3.0 KiTS19 profile, 600-minute phase plan and comparable result before running.

conditions_present: Release, benchmark, accuracy tier and Offline scenario are stated.
missing: Correct accuracy criterion, artifacts/configs, DICE rule, result ID/tolerance, phase duration and limits.
provider: Benchmark owner corrects acceptance and selects result.
Platform owner approves long GPU load.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory GPU/topology/runtime/storage and inspect v3.0 artifact/result metadata.
prohibited_until_resolved: Download/run/tune, use BERT evidence, clear logs or PASS.

revision_candidate.purpose: Execute the approved MLPerf Inference v3.0 3D-UNet normal-accuracy Offline configuration, verify KiTS19 volumetric-segmentation accuracy plus LoadGen/compliance validity, measure Offline samples per second, and compare with a signed comparable v3.0 result.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact SUT/GPU topology, driver/runtime, v3.0 container/harness commit, 3D-UNet model, KiTS19 data/preprocessing and configs. Newer releases and other medical-image pipelines are not interchangeable.
revision_candidate.target_scope: 3D-UNet 99 Offline only across the configured GPU set. BERT, Server and 99.9 are excluded. Machine Time 600 and Attended Time 90 must be mapped to accuracy, performance, compliance and setup phases without shortening an approved active workload.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Pinned v3.0 harness/container; licensed model/KiTS19 data and preprocessing hashes; configs; accuracy/performance/compliance commands; 600-minute phase map; DICE and Offline samples/s criteria; comparable result ID; tuning, memory/storage, thermal/power and recovery limits.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify hashes/configs and baseline health, then run 3D-UNet 99 accuracy, Offline performance and required compliance phases exactly as the pinned v3.0 implementation specifies. Preserve volumetric accuracy output, LoadGen logs, preprocessing identity, GPU-memory telemetry and full phase timing. Do not run BERT validation.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Conflict corrected; artifacts licensed/pinned; adequate GPU memory, storage, cooling and power; all GPUs healthy; tuning/load/recovery approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: System/GPU identity; all hashes/configs; KiTS19 preprocessing manifest; exact commands and phase durations; DICE/accuracy result; complete LoadGen logs and valid Offline samples/s; compliance; GPU memory/power/thermal/XID/ECC/host logs; named comparable v3.0 result and normalized comparison; final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed v3.0 3D-UNet 99 Offline rules and comparable result. Pass requires the required DICE accuracy, valid LoadGen/compliance, samples/s comparison and clean health. BERT validity or throughput alone is invalid.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not mix model/accuracy/scenario/release, use unlicensed medical data, alter preprocessing/tuning without approval, expose restricted data, clear logs, suppress invalidity or claim official status.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Benchmark/data/platform owners approve artifacts, preprocessing, reference, 600-minute plan and load; a human judges comparability and final disposition.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans correct BERT and decide duration/reference. The Agent executes only the pinned 3D-UNet workflow.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop on invalidity or resource limits, preserve permitted evidence, terminate cleanly, restore tuning/services and verify GPU/host health before rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: BERT conflict, duration plan or reference unresolved; wrong model/scenario/release; missing license/config; DICE/LoadGen/compliance failure; memory/storage exhaustion; topology drift; XID/ECC/thermal/power/host limit; evidence loss.

identified_defects: No KiTS19/DICE or comparable result identity.
reason_for_change: Preserve the medical-image 3D-UNet workload and require its own DICE/preprocessing evidence rather than a copied BERT criterion.
